about: v0.18.0 verification V3 (M6.1): every Repeat case of a stop the last price has passed. Each case is a book row, the contract's lot and tick, and the last price. 'sends' is the request Place sent for it on v0.17.0 (6787dfae6), recorded through the real ticket in Analyze mode and in Live before the words changed (the same in both modes); 'says' is the passed-trigger line in each mode from v0.18.0.
